Team —

Quick heads-up on ACME (renewal due 2028-01-15). Finance asked for a cleaned forecast and evidence package by EOD Friday so they can finalize the ARR roll-forward. Primary asks below: 

1) Evidence sweep: confirm each stage has required artifacts (SOW, usage reports, security attestation where required). I attached a checklist to drive the collection. Please flag any missing items by Wednesday. (attachment: acme_evidence_checklist.xlsx)

2) Forecast cleanse: pull the latest committed ARR and current probability per HubSpot. We need the committed amount and a proposal for conservative/optimistic scenarios. Put a short note on what would trigger a probability change (usage < 60% last 30d, open support tickets > 3, exec churn).

3) Churn-tagging: if there are active renewal concerns (pricing pushback, procurement delays), tag the deal as "at-risk—evidence" and set a temporary probability floor of 30% until evidence is complete.

Owners: Naomi — evidence collection; David — forecast numbers and probability scenarios. I will own external coordination and procurement follow-up.

Deliverables: short snapshot CSV in the shared drive + updated HubSpot deal record with notes and evidence links.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sr. Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_evidence_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 34KB)

Thanks for the heads-up and the checklist. We're pulling the addendum and procurement notes now — Tom will upload the signed addendum by end of day Thursday. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Finance is asking for a clear definition of "committed" vs "best-case" numbers. We need Redwood to confirm what your finance team treats as "committed" in this context so our FP&A can reconcile.

Laura / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the PO. On the two questions: 

1) Committed vs best-case — For Redwood finance, "committed" = contractually signed and countersigned SOW/addendum + no outstanding commercial conditions (PO accepted or payment terms agreed). "Best-case" = additional upsell/expansion items we expect to land in the quarter but not yet contractually committed. I'll include a short note in HubSpot with definitions so FP&A can map them directly.

2) PoC vendor risk — noted. David, please model a conservative scenario with a 10% ARR hit and an optimistic scenario with 3% hit; include a note on time-to-resolution and vendor overlap. Naomi — mark this deal as "at-risk—procurement" until the addendum is fully countersigned.

Action items / owners and ETA:
- Naomi: final evidence bundle and HubSpot link (Thu EOD).
- David: forecast scenarios (conservative/optimistic) and updated ARR numbers (Thu noon).
- Sergio: follow up with LA finance if we need an early reclass for the roll-forward (Thu afternoon).

Laura — let's tentatively schedule a 20-minute touch on Thu 2pm PT if that works for you; I'll send a calendar invite.

Sergio Alvarez
